definitions.explanation: Being of the same sex or gender. Used in social, legal, and relationship contexts.

examples.japanese: {同性|どうせい}の{友人|ゆうじん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I have many friends of the same sex.

examples.japanese: {同性|どうせい}{婚|こん}を{認|みと}める{国|くに}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of countries recognizing same-sex marriage is increasing.

examples.japanese: {同性|どうせい}のカップルにも{平等|びょうどう}な{権利|けんり}を{求|もと}める{声|こえ}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: Calls for equal rights for same-sex couples are growing.

notes:
USAGE:
Frequently used as a modifier ({同性|どうせい}の) or in compounds like {同性婚|どうせいこん} (same-sex marriage) and {同性愛|どうせいあい} (homosexuality).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同性婚|どうせいこん} (same-sex marriage)
- {同性愛|どうせいあい} (homosexuality)
- {同性|どうせい}の{友人|ゆうじん} (friend of the same sex)
- {同性|どうせい}カップル (same-sex couple)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {異性|いせい}: opposite sex — the antonym
- {同棲|どうせい}: cohabitation, living together — a homophone with completely different meaning and kanji
- {両性|りょうせい}: both sexes
